title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: AWS
providers.scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: Maximum session duration
controls.what: Caps role session length at 1-12 hours (default 1 hour).
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > Edit > Maximum session duration; UpdateRole

controls.name: Revoke active sessions (AWSRevokeOlderSessions)
controls.what: Attaches a deny-all policy for sessions issued before now, invalidating existing temporary credentials for the role.
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > role > Revoke sessions tab

controls.name: aws:TokenIssueTime deny policy
controls.what: Deny policy that blocks temporary credentials issued before a chosen time; does not affect long-term keys.

controls.name: Role trust policy
controls.what: The trust policy decides which principals can assume a role; removing a principal stops new sessions for it.
controls.setting: IAM console > Roles > Trust relationships / aws iam update-assume-role-policy

controls.name: Delete IAM identity provider
controls.what: Deleting the IAM OIDC or SAML identity provider removes the trust used for federated role sessions.

controls_unknown: Whether long-term Bedrock API keys can be set to never expire, and their maximum lifetime.

auth_paths.name: OIDC / SAML federation to IAM roles (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, AssumeRoleWithSAML)

authentication.summary: An external IdP token (OIDC JWT, e.g. GitHub Actions, or SAML assertion) is exchanged with STS for temporary role credentials. The exchange needs no AWS credentials.

federation.details: Credentials are issued only after the IdP authenticates the workload or user; IdP policy applies at token issuance, not to already-issued AWS credentials.

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. It is evaluated on every signed API request. aws:SourceIp is absent for calls through VPC endpoints (use aws:VpcSourceIp) and SCPs do not cover the management account.

lifetime.summary: Default 1 h, up to role max (12 h)

renewal.summary: Get a fresh IdP token and call the STS exchange again.

administration.summary: Admins create the IAM OIDC/SAML identity provider and role trust policy conditions; revoke active sessions per role.
administration.conditions: Session revocation applies per role, not per external identity.

sso.details: Credentials are issued only after the external IdP authenticates the user and returns a SAML assertion or OIDC token.

offboard.details: Disabling the user at the IdP stops new assertions, but temporary credentials already issued stay valid until they expire.

sso.ui: IAM console > Identity providers > Add provider > SAML or OpenID Connect; role trust policy names that provider
sso.cli: aws iam create-saml-provider; aws iam create-open-id-connect-provider

network.ui: Role identity policy with Deny * / NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp, or AWS Organizations console > Policies > Service control policies > Create policy (Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp) > attach to OU/account
network.cli: aws iam put-role-policy (inline deny) or aws organizations attach-policy

reads.ui: CloudTrail console > Trails > trail > Data events > Edit > enable S3 data events; then filter trail logs on eventName=GetObject (not in Event history)

kill.ui: IAM console > Roles > role > Revoke sessions tab > Revoke active sessions (attaches AWSRevokeOlderSessions)

offboard.ui: Disable the user in the IdP; then IAM console > Roles > role > Revoke sessions > Revoke active sessions to end issued credentials

log_sources.name: AWS CloudTrail event history
log_sources.notes: On by default; 90 days of management events per Region; free. Data events (e.g. S3 GetObject) not included.

log_sources.name: CloudTrail trail / event data store
log_sources.notes: Needed for retention beyond 90 days; data events off by default and cost extra.

credential_id_fields.notes: Key ID used to sign the request; may be empty for security reasons.

anomaly_cues: Unexpected OIDC subject or repo in exchange

containment.steps: Revoke active sessions on the role; tighten trust policy conditions (aud/sub); remove or disable at the IdP.

calls.log_notes: All STS calls logged as management events; cannot be denied by policy.
